metadata.scenario: A new customer reports dissatisfaction with the installation service, claiming the technician left a mess. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Michael Brown. I’m calling about some issues we’ve had with the service. I'm sorry to hear that, Michael. What seems to be the problem? Well, the technician who came to provide care for my father really left a mess. I apologize for that. Can you tell me more about what happened? Yes, there were supplies and wrappers everywhere. It felt very unprofessional and disrespectful to our home. I completely understand your frustration, and that’s not the standard we strive for at CareFirst. It was really disappointing, especially since we are relying on you for my father’s care. I’m truly sorry to hear that. We value your trust, and I’d like to address this immediately. Thank you, I appreciate that. What will you do about it? I will escalate this to our quality assurance team, and we will review it with the technician involved. That sounds good. I hope it can be resolved quickly. Absolutely, I will ensure we follow up with you within 24 hours regarding this issue. Okay, thank you. I also want to discuss my father's care plan. Of course, what specific services are you concerned about? He needs wound care and medication management due to his diabetes. We offer both services. Our wound care is priced at $75 to $95 per visit, and medication management is $65 to $80. That sounds reasonable. How often would you recommend these services? For wound care, I’d recommend visits at least twice a week, and medication management could be once a week. Alright, can you help me set that up? Yes, I can connect you with our Care Coordinator for scheduling. Great, thank you! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything for now. Thank you for your patience, Michael. I’ll make sure to get this resolved for you. I appreciate that, Margaret. You’re welcome! Have a great day, and we’ll be in touch soon. Thank you, bye. Goodbye!
